# Speero <> GrowthBook: Circus 2027
Date: 2026-09-08 | Duration: 43m

## Summary
Growth Book reported that its business tripled in size, now serving more than 3,000 companies, including over 150 enterprise customers and more than 1,000 self-serve paid plans, with major clients such as Anthropic, Xai, Mistral, Salesforce, and Wikipedia. Its Open Core model supports small developer teams through a free version while Pro and enterprise offerings add governance, scalability, and optimized data pipelines. The product combines experimentation, feature flagging, product analytics, and AI-enabled automation integrated with tools such as Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code. The parties discussed a comprehensive 2027 event partnership for London and a US conference, including sponsorship discounts, speaker sourcing, co-marketing, ABM, customer storytelling, and six months of preparation. The US event may move from Austin to New York to attract more high-value practitioners. Standard sponsorship is around $100K per event, with discounts linked to co-sponsorship and active support. Ben Labay will send a detailed proposal within 24 hours, followed by discussions on messaging, analytics, and technical capabilities.

## Keywords
Growth Book, feature flagging, experimentation, Circus 2027, partnership, event sponsorship

## Action Items

**Ben Labay**
Send updated sponsorship proposal and commercial pitch for Circus 2027 events, including decision tree for location options (London, Austin, possible New York) within 24 hours (32:27)
Follow up on agreement discussions and refine event partnership terms after sending the sponsorship proposal (32:38)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Provide potential speakers and customer champions for event participation and content collaboration (18:42)
Engage with Speero team on co-marketing, content planning, and moderation roles as part of the six-month pre-event partnership activities (14:44)

**Lyndsie Berens**
Coordinate on executive-level attendee recruitment for events and support joint marketing efforts (25:26)

**Jonny Longden**
Continue developing shared narrative around feature flagging, experimentation, and telemetry to align with Growth Book’s offerings and event themes (27:33)
